note: The top-level Variant Type token is read from the JSON input; this candidate sets it to 22 so the Variant body is treated as an ExtensionObject.
Because the input-selected Variant type is ExtensionObject, the Body field is decoded by the unwrapping helper using the same Variant object as destination.
The nested TypeId from the ExtensionObject body is decoded from the input; this candidate uses Id 7, selecting the UInt32 datatype.
Memory is allocated for the unwrapped UInt32 value and stored in the Variant's data pointer.
When decoding the input Body string as UInt32 fails, the allocated Variant data is freed but the Variant data pointer is not reset to NULL.
The failed decode causes generic cleanup of the partially decoded Variant object that still contains the stale data pointer.
Variant cleanup frees the same stale Variant data pointer again, producing the heap double free.
